newsitem.title: EGYPT: PRESS DIGEST - Egypt economic press - April 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Egypt economic press - April 27.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian economic press this week. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Official at Capital Market Authority (CMA) says Banque du Caire has submitted request to issue bonds worth 100 million pounds ($29.46 million), making it the first of the four major public sector banks to do so. Official says CMA studying request by Nationale Societe Generale bank to issue bonds worth 150 million pounds.

- Subscription opens in Egyptian Kuwaiti Holding Company share offer. Company offers three million shares, the equivalent of 25 percent of its total shares, worth $30 million for sale to the public. Investors must buy a minimum of 500 shares.

- American Express Bank mutual fund oversubscribed 3.1 times, says an official at the bank. The bank had increased the value of the fund to 300 million form the 100 million it had intitially offered. It will pay income twice a year and is managed by Hermes Fund Management.

- Egyptian Gulf Bank raised value of its mutual fund from 50 million pounds to 100 million after strong investor interest, an official at the bank said. Fund will pay income twice a year and is managed by Hermes Fund Management.
- Central Egypt Flour Mills pre-tax profits for first eight months of 1996/7 financial year stable at 30 million pounds. Revenues down to 43.5 million pounds from 45 million in same year ago period.

- North Cairo Flour Mills unaudited pre-tax profits for first eight months ending February down to 78.013 million pounds from 82.839 million in same period in the previous year. Revenues were 608.37 million pounds from 546.79 in the same year ago period.

- Heliopolis Housing and Development net after-tax profit for first nine months of current financial year up 16.3 percent to 67.625 million pounds from 58.142 million in the same year ago period. Revenue was 96.93 million pounds compared to 77.63 million during the same period in the previous year.

- Southern Cairo Flour Mills pre-tax profits for first nine months up to 22.544 million pounds from 22.474 million during the same period last year. Company aims to double pre-tax profits for 1996/97 financial year to 30 million pounds. Company chairman Rafik Shalabi said state's Holding Company for Rice and Flour Mills may sell 9.5 percent of its stake in Southern Cairo, thereby increasing private sector stake to 49.5 percent of company.

- Egyptian Financial and Industrial net after-tax profit in first eight months up 67.5 percent to 29.74 million pounds from 17.75 million. Net sales were 142.2 million pounds compared to 124.4 million in same year ago period.

- Strong interest in second tranche of shares offered in Development and Engineering Consultancy. Holding company wanted to sell 10 percent of its stake in Development and Engineering Consultancy. Brokers said investor interest prompted it to sell its remaining 15.4 percent stake in company.
- Alexandria Commercial and Maritime Bank LE sold 26 percent of its shares to the public, at 301 pounds per share -- double original share price of 140 pounds.
- Banque Misr wants to increase capital of its two mutual funds by 100 million pounds each.
